description: Implementation of per-thread semaphore functions for synchronization in the Abseil library, including thread blocking counters, wait/poke mechanisms, and thread identity management.

classes.name: PerThreadSem
classes.description: Class providing per-thread semaphore operations for thread synchronization.

methods.name: SetThreadBlockedCounter
methods.description: Sets the counter for the number of threads blocked in the current thread's context.

methods.name: GetThreadBlockedCounter
methods.description: Retrieves the current thread's blocked thread counter.

methods.name: Tick
methods.description: Updates the thread's ticker and potentially pokes the thread if it has been idle for too long.
